offset_semantics.address_kind: All offsets are RVAs relative to the libUE4.so ELF load bias, not file offsets or absolute addresses.
offset_semantics.gactivity: Address of an android_app* global slot. Read the pointer at base + RVA; android_app.activity is at +0x18. This is not a JNI jobject.
offset_semantics.gnames: Address of a pointer to the legacy name chunk table. Read once at base + RVA, then read chunk[id / 16384], then entry[id % 16384]; ANSI bytes begin at entry + 12.
offset_semantics.gobjects: Reference-dumper compatibility anchor at 0x17E8B538 inside a custom global object registry; first object-item array pointer at +0x10. It is not a complete standard GUObjectArray layout. Enclosing global referenced by code is 0x17E8B480; arrays at its +0xC8 and capacities at +0xE8.
offset_semantics.gengine: User-supplied RVA verified by reading the global pointer and resolving the live object and class through GNames.
